audiences.jobToBeDone: Understand Tolani governance, TUT utility and eligible participation without confusing token possession or voting with legal DAO membership or investment rights.

offers.description: Governance, utility, evidence, treasury-policy and eligible-participation information.

valueProposition: Provide the canonical governance, TUT utility and evidence-authority layer for the Tolani ecosystem.
differentiators: Canonical Tolani Ecosystem DAO governance authority
Human treasury authorization before economic execution
prohibitedClaims: Guaranteed token value, price appreciation or liquidity
Dividend, revenue-share, interest, principal or equity claims
TUT possession or voting automatically creates legal DAO membership
Subsidiary ownership or commercial claims that belong to operating subsidiaries
Any claim that a source-system evidence receipt automatically authorizes TUT issuance

operationalHandoff.system: TUT Utility & Evidence Authority Plane v1; production minting, transfer execution and active entity acceptance remain disabled until separately authorized.

legalAndCompliance.rule: Utility and governance messaging must not be reframed as investment solicitation. TUT possession, delegation or voting does not by itself establish legal DAO membership.
